newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends off highs on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends off highs on profit-taking.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Late profit-taking and selling emerged to trim earlier gains at the close due to a lower-than-expected export data by SGS. Prices had earlier risen on news of a larger fall in the January production. The market appears uncertain and waiting for new leads.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest seen among nearbys as players returned from the festive holidays.
Ivan Wong who normally releases his report on the 14th of every month has decided to postpone the data to sometime this week.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) has postponed its January palm oil stock/export/output data to February 22 from February 15.

Morning prices surged on news that the Malaysian Oil Palm Growers' Council (MPOGC) estimated Malaysia's crude palm oil output in January at 570,000 tonnes, down 10.6 percent from December, against crop forecaster Ivan Wong's estimate of 578,000 tonnes.
New third trading month, May futures ended four ringgit higher at 1,306 ringgit ($525.13) a tonne after trading at a high of 1,315 ringgit.

Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered 1,365 ringgit against bids of 1,360 with earlier trades done at 1,360. Feb (central) saw offers at 1,362.50 and bids at 1,357.50 and Feb (north) at 1,360 against 1,352.50.
Mar (south) was offered at 1,365 with bids at 1,355, and Mar (central) at 1,357.50 with bids at 1,347.50.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $572.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $565 and Apr/May/Jun at $560. Mar was traded at $570.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $602.50, Apr at $595 and Apr/May/Jun at $590. Mar was traded at $600 and Apr/May/Jun at $587.50.
Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $467.50 and Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50.
